public_rationale: On October 2, 2024, Zitron wrote that OpenAI would have to raise another round at least as large as its $6.5 billion to $7 billion round by July 2025. On March 31, 2025, OpenAI announced $40 billion in new funding, and SoftBank disclosed a signed agreement for up to $40 billion with a $10 billion first closing planned for mid-April 2025. Both dates are before the end of July 2025, and both amounts exceed the threshold.
limitations: This record assesses only whether such a round was raised in time. It does not assess Zitron's reasoning that OpenAI needed the money to survive.
SoftBank's release gives the April 2025 first closing as planned. This packet does not include a document confirming that the payment completed.
Most of the $40 billion was scheduled after the horizon and was conditional on a restructuring. The threshold is met by the first closing alone.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: After closing its round of about $6.5 billion to $7 billion (October 2024), OpenAI will raise another funding round of at least the same size by July 2025.
conditions: once it has raised its current ($6.5 billion to $7 billion) round

statement.excerpt: I believe that OpenAI, once it has raised its current ($6.5 billion to $7 billion) round, will have to raise another round of at least the same size by July 2025, if not sooner.

from_speaker: will have to raise another round
of at least the same size
our_interpretation: We read 'will have to raise' as a forecast that OpenAI would raise such a round. We do not assess whether OpenAI needed the money.
We read 'by July 2025' as on or before 2025-07-31.
We count a round as raised when OpenAI announces it and an investor discloses a signed agreement with a first closing inside the horizon.
criteria.support_condition: Between 2024-10-02 and 2025-07-31, OpenAI announced a new funding round of at least $6.5 billion, backed by a signed investment agreement.
criteria.contradiction_condition: By 2025-07-31, OpenAI had announced no new funding round of at least $6.5 billion after its October 2024 round.
